title: What the model is worth, with the range and the assumptions attached
prescribes: Convert a model result into money through an explicit chain -- population, effect size, value per unit -- attach a confidence range, and name every assumption that moves the total.
applied: Used the skill's revenue_impact.py, confidence_interval.py and cost_savings.py on the actual test-split confusion matrix at the value-maximising threshold.
narrative: The chain is explicit: at threshold 0.20 the model flags 668 of 1409 test customers, of whom 333 genuinely churn. At a 30% save rate that is 100 customers retained, worth $1,732 of gross margin each at a 2.65% monthly churn rate -- $172,997 gross, $157,270 discounted at 10%.

Every one of those numbers is an assumption except the confusion matrix. That is why the estimate is published as a band -- $94,362 to $251,631 (Medium confidence (−40% / +60%)) -- rather than as the false precision of a single figure.

Campaign cost is the part people forget: 668 offers at $100 is $66,800, against $189,406 of lifetime margin protected. Net $122,606 on the test split alone, and roughly $612,855 scaled to the full 7,043-customer book.

The soft benefit is quantified separately and kept separate: replacing a manual retention review (12 months x 3 analysts x 6 hours) is $0 of freed time. It is real, it is smaller, and mixing it into the headline would make the headline unfalsifiable.

charts.title: Expected campaign value by decision threshold
charts.note: Net value peaks at 0.20; below it the false-positive offers cost more than they save.

code_excerpt:
retention = retention_improvement(saved_customers=tp * SAVE_RATE,
                                  avg_ltv=median_mrr * GROSS_MARGIN / MONTHLY_CHURN,
                                  discount_rate=0.10)
band = build_range(retention['discounted_ltv_impact'], confidence='medium')
# published as a band, because four of the five inputs are assumptions
takeaway: The campaign is worth about $122,606 on the test split at threshold 0.20 -- but four of the five inputs are assumptions, so it ships as a range with those assumptions named.
